name: Cable

abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Concussion: Etkilenen şampiyonların yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.True Strike: Saldırılar Zırh, Direnç, Otomatik Blok ve Kaçışı (Evade) yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Tek tehlikesi güç barı dolunca %25 şansla max canının %20'sini pasif iyileşmesi — iyileşme engeli veya petrify ile kontrol et. Asla kanatma, kanarsa rakibe degeneration uygular.
signatureAbility:
Techno Organic Virus Suppression
Cable's Power Efficiencies gain [5 - 55.15]% increased potency.
While the Opponent has an Endurance effect, Stun Debuffs on them cannot have their duration reduced.
immunityDetails:
• %100 Zehir direnci 🧪
• Kanama hasarının %100'ünü geri kazanır 🩸

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Cable has a 100% chance to gain a 12% Power Efficiency Passive over 10 seconds each time he fills a bar of power. Max Stacks 2.
Each time he fills a Bar of Power, Cable has a 25% chance to gain a Regeneration Passive, healing 20% of missing Health over 10 seconds.
When Cable is inflicted with a Bleed effect, he attempts to go back in time and heal himself. If he triggered a personal Regeneration the last time he crossed a Bar of Power, he gains another.

abilitySections.title: Degeneration
content: 100% Chance on Cable's Heavy to inflict non-#Robot Opponents with a Degeneration Debuff, dealing [21,149.1] Direct Damage over 20 seconds. Max Stacks 8.
When he's inflicted with a Bleed effect, Cable inflicts this Degeneration on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit inflicts a 5% Daunted Passive for 25 seconds. These can be inflicted through Block.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit of this attack inflicts an Incinerate Debuff, dealing [20,142] Energy Damage over 45 seconds.
While this Incinerate is active, this Special Attack is disabled. Cable's Degenerations are paused during his Special Attacks activated while this Incinerate is active.
While Cable is suffering from his own Power Lock, This Special Attack is Unblockable.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Cable unleashes more of his Mutant power than he should, gaining a non-stacking 40% Power Efficiency Passive for 16 seconds, but suffering from a Power Lock Passive while it's active as his Techo-Organic Virus roams unchecked.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Techno Organic Virus Suppression
content: Cable's Power Efficiencies gain [5 - 55.15]% increased potency.
While the Opponent has an Endurance effect, Stun Debuffs on them cannot have their duration reduced.
